definitions.explanation: selecting someone for an important position based on talent rather than seniority

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抜擢|ばってき}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A young person was promoted to department head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{異例|いれい}→異例：13564_irei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抜擢|ばってき}だった。
⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見込|みこ}まれて→見込む：08315_mikomu⟧{抜擢|ばってき}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They were selected because their talent was recognized.

notes:
{抜擢|ばってき} refers to selecting someone for a position based on merit, often skipping normal seniority.

WORD TYPE:
- Noun
- Also used as ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {抜擢|ばってき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to select/promote)
- Commonly in passive: {抜擢|ばってき}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be selected/promoted)

WRITING:
- {抜|ばつ} (pull out, select)
- {擢|てき} (select)
- {擢|てき} is a rare kanji
- Sometimes written: {抜|ばっ}てき

KEY FEATURE:
- Implies selection based on ability, not seniority
- Breaking from Japanese traditional ⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧ (seniority system)
- Often described as ⟦{異例|いれい}→異例：13564_irei⟧ (unusual/exceptional)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抜擢|ばってき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to select/promote)
- {抜擢|ばってき}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be selected)
- ⟦{異例|いれい}→異例：13564_irei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抜擢|ばってき} (unusual promotion)
- 大{抜擢|ばってき} (major promotion)
- ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜擢|ばってき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (promote young talent)

USAGE:
- Corporate promotions
- Sports team selections
- Political appointments
- Entertainment industry casting
- Positive connotation (recognition of talent)
- Implies someone deserving was chosen
- Can cause controversy if seen as favoritism

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧ (promotion - standard)
- ⟦{登用|とうよう}→登用：17153_touyou⟧ (appointment, employment)
- ⟦{起用|きよう}→起用：14397_kiyou⟧ (appointment, selection)

DIFFERENCE FROM {昇進|しょうしん}:
- {抜擢|ばってき}: Merit-based, often unexpected
- ⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧: Standard career advancement

REGISTER: Formal. Common in business news and official announcements.
